extension.summary: Everyone in the household keeps their own watch history, through your own CrossWatch.
extension.description: CrossWatch (crosswatch.app) is a free, self-hosted app that keeps watch history, ratings and playback progress in sync between media servers such as Plex, Jellyfin and Emby and trackers such as Trakt and Simkl, with a profile per person. This add-on needs a running CrossWatch on your network.[CR][CR]It reports what plays in Kodi, and who is watching, so each person's history reaches their own accounts. The viewer is worked out from smart playlist membership, the active Kodi profile, or a question when playback stops, remembered per show. Optionally, rate an episode or film after watching it.[CR][CR]Maintained by Rouzax, not by the CrossWatch project: report add-on problems on GitHub or in the forum thread.
extension.news: v1.0.0~beta3 (2026-10-15) - Add viewer can list the people from your CrossWatch user profiles: tick them instead of typing names (needs CrossWatch v0.13.5). - Viewers picked from that list, or whose name matches a profile, follow a rename made in CrossWatch. - Their remembered answers and any watches waiting to be sent follow the rename too. - Viewer names are compared the way CrossWatch v0.13.5 does: accents now count.
